title: Meet 'Snow White'
content: (Link to video on Facebook)This is Snow White, a mixed-breed female hoping for a loving home in New York's Hudson Valley area. I sketched her in gouache at theDutchess County SPCA.The idea was to practice some animal sketching and hopefully help a dog find a home.----Link to Snow White's page at the DCSPCAPreviously:Donald Colley's Dog SketchesVideo Download:Painting Animals from Life
